summary: Shim6 is a mechanism for site multihoming in IPv6, letting hosts keep connections working when a site has several providers. This informational RFC discusses considerations on where Shim6 and its support protocols apply.

eli5.summary: If your house has two roads, a shim helps you switch roads without the mail getting lost. This memo talks about when that trick makes sense.

questions: what is ipv6 multihoming with shim6
